title: spec2_1p1z_freq~
description: `spec2_1p1z_freq~` filters a spectrum with a one-pole, one-zero IIR filter, first from left to right and then from right to left. Like other `iem_spec2` processing, it operates on only block size / 2 + 1 spectral samples; the help patch demonstrates coefficient triplets such as `0.5 0 0.5`.
